stories.headline: Anthropic rival says companies can (mostly) skip the pricey models

stories.headline: Want to see your live AI usage on your Mac’s icons? This clever new app lets you
stories.summary: IconSwapper brings your Mac's app icons to life with real-time data, animations, and playful customizations that make your desktop more fun.

stories.headline: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
stories.summary: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg , which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant.
